# GDPR audit prep (Alireza Rezvani)

Six article-cited questions a data protection officer would ask before a GDPR audit.

- Source: https://github.com/alirezarezvani/claude-skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alirezarezvani/claude-skills/main/compliance-os/skills/gdpr-audit-prep/SKILL.md
- Author: Alireza Rezvani
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/gdpr-audit-prep-alireza-rezvani-5e2f5191

Pressure-tests privacy compliance before an internal audit, breach response, regulator inquiry or acquisition due diligence. Claude works through six questions tied to GDPR articles: the Article 30 record of processing, lawful basis under Article 6, DPIAs under Article 35, data subject request handling, transfer impact assessments and the breach log. The output is a structured audit-prep report with gaps per area.

**Try asking:**
- "Run the GDPR audit prep for our new analytics pipeline"
- "We had a data breach last week. What do we need to have ready for the regulator?"
- "Check our DSAR process against what an auditor will ask"
